phase: Phase 14: Mesh Repeater, Audio DSP & Convoy Simulation

stories.title: Audio DSP Hardening: Pure KMP Automatic Gain Control (AGC) & Dynamic Range Compression (DRC)
stories.description: Implement pure Kotlin multiplatform Automatic Gain Control (AutomaticGainControl.kt) and Dynamic Range Compression (DynamicRangeCompressor.kt) for helmet intercom audio: dynamic RMS speech normalization across whispering and screaming, soft-knee compression curve, anti-pumping envelope follower, and lookahead peak limiter with zero Java/C dependencies.
acceptanceCriteria: Pure Kotlin Multiplatform with zero Java (java.security.*) or C/JNI dependencies (Rule 3)
AGC normalizes speech level to target RMS (-18 dBFS) within 150ms without noise floor pumping
DRC applies soft-knee compression (ratio 4:1) and hard-limiting ceiling at -0.5 dBFS preventing clipping
100% test pass on JVM and compileKotlinIosSimulatorArm64 (Rule 6)

stories.title: Autonomous Mesh Repeater & Basecamp Beacon Mode
stories.description: Implement specialized low-power stationary mesh repeater service (MeshRepeaterService.kt) and node manager: bypass local mic/speaker pipelines to save CPU/battery, prioritize BLE GATT packet flooding relay with dynamic power-saving duty cycle, advertise stationary basecamp beacon telemetry, and support remote repeater diagnostic ping.
acceptanceCriteria: Zero microphone/speaker buffer allocations when repeater mode is active
Multi-hop packet forwarding latency < 15ms per hop on stationary node
Broadcasts periodic low-overhead REPEATER_BEACON with battery percentage and active neighbor count
Full unit test suite verifying packet forwarding and beacon emission

stories.title: Automated Multi-Node Mesh Field Simulation Harness
stories.description: Implement automated 8-node virtual mesh convoy simulation harness (ConvoyMeshSimulationHarness.kt): simulate moving convoy line formation with realistic path loss, dynamic RF dropouts (canyon pass scenarios), out-of-order packet arrival, and verify 100% PFS session ratchet recovery and audio jitter playout.
acceptanceCriteria: Simulates 8 distinct virtual peers communicating over virtual RF propagation matrix
Validates multi-hop TTL decrement and loop suppression across 3 hops in real time
Tests 25% packet drop and verify MeshKeyRatchet skipped-key recovery handles out-of-order frames
Full automated test suite executing under 5 seconds with zero flaky timings

stories.title: Seamless Mesh OTA Group Re-Keying & Dynamic Epoch Migration
stories.description: Implement decentralized Over-The-Air (OTA) group re-keying and epoch migration manager (GroupEpochManager.kt): dual-epoch overlapping transition window allowing old and new cryptographic keys to coexist for 30 seconds, consensus epoch beaconing, and zero drop of active voice streams during key rotation.
acceptanceCriteria: Supports dual-epoch concurrent decryption during transition window
Leader initiates EPOCH_ROLLOVER frame; peers verify leader signature and derive new master secret
Zero packet drops or audio interruption during active speech when epoch rolls over
Full unit test suite verifying multi-peer epoch migration
